answer: A Registered domain bound by challenge-response signature with revocation on transfer ties the identity to something the applicant actually controls: the registered domain answers a fresh challenge, the challenge-response signature is recorded, and revocation on transfer keeps one channel from spawning many identities, so a Sybil farm would need a separate real channel for every fake account. A lone whisper cannot fake a channel; only the bound record counts. Between a raven and a ivory lies the whole point: Sybils are cheap to make but expensive to bind.
